mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_space WHERE space_id=#{spaceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_space SET name=#{space.name},description=#{space.description},visibility=#{space.visibility}, status=#{space.status},version=#{space.version},updated_by=#{space.updatedBy},updated_at=#{space.updatedAt} WHERE id=#{space.id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND system_space=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ks.id,ks.space_id,ks.code,ks.name,ks.description,ks.visibility,ks.status, ks.system_space,ks.version,ks.created_by,ks.created_at,ks.updated_by,ks.updated_at FROM knowledge_space ks JOIN app_user account ON account.user_id=#{userId} AND account.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN user_space_membership membership ON membership.space_id=ks.space_id AND membership.user_id=#{userId} AND membership.status='ACTIVE' WHERE ks.status='ACTIVE' AND (ks.visibility='ENTERPRISE' OR membership.id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY ks.system_space DESC,ks.name ASC,ks.space_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ks.id) FROM knowledge_space ks JOIN app_user account ON account.user_id=#{userId} AND account.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN user_space_membership membership ON membership.space_id=ks.space_id AND membership.user_id=#{userId} AND membership.status='ACTIVE' WHERE ks.status='ACTIVE' AND (ks.visibility='ENTERPRISE' OR membership.id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT FROM user_space_membership WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND space_id=#{spaceId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_space_membership WHERE space_id=#{spaceId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_space_membership WHERE space_id=#{spaceId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND role='MANAGER'
